name: Pancham
notes: Painted design: off-white head/back fur painted with fine radial strokes and whorls (strokes about 5-8 texels), grey soft shading blobs under the ears and limbs (painted occlusion, not markings); charcoal arms/legs/ears/eye patch with coarser strokes; a flat green leaf (island 3); two red-brown dots and a dark nose blob.

So: fur along the painted strokes everywhere: white fur a little longer and softer, charcoal fur slightly shorter; the head spikes and cheek tufts share the white fur; ear islands get a softer edge band. Leaf: waxy, a little glossier, only its painted grain plus a faint midrib along its long axis (left untouched if it reads as an added pattern). Dots and nose untouched; painted grey blobs are colour only.
Body shader has no normal sampler (manifest normal null): in game only _dif and _par load; the fur relief is cache-only in Body_nor and faint as baked cavity in _dif / AO in _par G.
